records.source: Dance Of The Moonlight Jellies
records.translation: Sayaw ng mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan

records.source: Hey. I'm paying my respects to another bygone summer. I'll come meet up with you when we launch the candle-boat.
records.translation: Hoy. Nagbibigay-galang ako sa isa na namang lumipas na tag-init. Susundan kita kapag pakakawalan na natin ang bangkang may kandila.

records.source: Such a rare and exciting thing...
records.translation: Napakapambihira at kapana-panabik nito...

records.source: *yawn*... It's past my bed-time.$s#$e#Hey, did you see that candle-boat? I crafted it myself.$h
records.translation: *hikab*... Lampas na sa oras ng pagtulog ko.$s#$e#Hoy, nakita mo ba ang bangkang may kandila? Ako mismo ang gumawa niyon.$h

records.source: The 'Moonlight Jelly'... what a remarkable species! We're very lucky that they stop here on their long journey south.#$e#It's unknown why they are attracted to light... very curious.
records.translation: Ang 'Dikyang Sinag-Buwan'... kahanga-hangang uri! Napakapalad nating humihinto sila rito sa mahaba nilang paglalakbay patimog.#$e#Hindi alam kung bakit sila naaakit sa liwanag... lubhang nakapagtataka.

records.source: It's kind of cold, actually. I guess fall is right around the corner.
records.translation: Medyo malamig talaga. Mukhang nalalapit na ang taglagas.

records.source: I thought I saw something moving in there... something big, something dark.#$e#Just trying to scare you...$h
records.translation: Akala ko may nakita akong gumagalaw roon... isang malaki at madilim na bagay.#$e#Tinatakot lang kita...$h

records.source: Psst... Make sure to swing by the shop tomorrow to get your fall seeds!
records.translation: Psst... Tiyaking dumaan ka sa tindahan bukas para bumili ng mga binhi para sa taglagas!

records.source: These candles are romantic, aren't they?
records.translation: Romantiko ang mga kandilang ito, hindi ba?

records.source: I'll just sneak up when the jellies arrive... I don't want to bother anyone.
records.translation: Palihim lang akong lalapit kapag dumating ang mga dikya... Ayokong makaabala kaninuman.

records.source: I can't believe summer's over... I feel like it just started.$s
records.translation: Hindi ako makapaniwalang tapos na ang tag-init... Parang kasisimula pa lang nito.$s

records.source: What, why are you looking at me like that? You think I'm too old to enjoy something like this?
records.translation: Ano, bakit ganyan ang tingin mo sa akin? Sa tingin mo, masyado na akong matanda para masiyahan sa ganito?

records.source: I remember seeing the jellies once, as a little girl. Oh, how I jumped with joy when they arrived!#$e#But that was long ago... I'm a lot less energetic now.
records.translation: Naaalala kong minsan ko nang nakita ang mga dikya noong bata pa ako. Ah, napatalon ako sa tuwa nang dumating sila!#$e#Pero napakatagal na niyon... Hindi na ako kasigla ngayon.

records.source: Good evening, @. The Moonlight Jellies are close... I already saw one glowing in the distance.#$b#Once we launch the candle-boat they'll come up to the docks and say hello.
records.translation: Magandang gabi, @. Malapit na ang mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan... May nakita na akong isang kumikislap sa malayo.#$b#Kapag pinakawalan natin ang bangkang may kandila, lalapit sila sa mga pantalan para bumati.

records.source: I wore my special shoes tonight... No one noticed.$s
records.translation: Isinuot ko ang espesyal kong sapatos ngayong gabi... Walang nakapansin.$s

records.source: Look out there, at the endless sea. Deep underwater, all kinds of life forms are moving around in the dark.#$b#Eerie, isn't it?
records.translation: Tumingin ka roon, sa walang-hanggang dagat. Sa kailaliman ng tubig, gumagalaw sa dilim ang sari-saring anyo ng buhay.#$b#Nakakakilabot, hindi ba?

records.source: Life is so easy for a jellyfish... just letting the waves carry you onward forever.
records.translation: Napakadali ng buhay para sa dikya... nagpapadala lang sa agos ng mga alon magpakailanman.

records.source: Don't tell Gus, but I'm a little disappointed there's no buffet tonight.
records.translation: Huwag mong sabihin kay Gus, pero medyo nadidismaya akong walang handaan ngayong gabi.

records.source: I'm gonna take a picture of the jellies when they arrive.
records.translation: Kukuhanan ko ng larawan ang mga dikya pagdating nila.

records.source: There! I just saw something glowing!#$b#Oh... It's gone.$s
records.translation: Doon! May nakita akong kumikislap!#$b#Ah... Nawala na.$s

records.source: Good evening, @. Hope you can find some time to relax before the harvest season.
records.translation: Magandang gabi, @. Sana makahanap ka ng oras para magpahinga bago ang panahon ng anihan.

records.source: I wonder if they're poisonous?#$e#Maybe I shouldn't push Sebastian in the water after all...$h
records.translation: Makamandag kaya sila?#$e#Baka hindi ko na nga dapat itulak si Sebastian sa tubig...$h

records.source: Hey. I'm paying my respects to another bygone summer.
records.translation: Hoy. Nagbibigay-galang ako sa isa na namang lumipas na tag-init.

records.source: The jellies were here a year ago, and they'll be back again a year from now... nature is amazing.
records.translation: Narito ang mga dikya noong nakaraang taon, at babalik silang muli isang taon mula ngayon... kahanga-hanga ang kalikasan.

records.source: That's a heavy load of people for an ancient wooden dock! I'll stay over here near the beach.
records.translation: Masyadong maraming tao para sa sinaunang pantalan na kahoy! Dito na lang ako malapit sa Dalampasigan.

records.source: If we keep polluting the oceans, the jellies will surely go extinct. It's already in the process of happening.#$e#What a shame... we have no respect for nature anymore.
records.translation: Kung patuloy nating dudumihan ang mga karagatan, tiyak na malilipol ang mga dikya. Nangyayari na iyon ngayon.#$e#Napakalungkot... wala na tayong paggalang sa kalikasan.

records.source: 'Moonlight Jellies'... I wonder how they taste?$h#$b#I would never try it, of course!$u
records.translation: 'Mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan'... Ano kaya ang lasa nila?$h#$b#Siyempre, hindi ko kailanman titikman!$u

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: How did you find me back here? I thought I was well-hidden.#$b#Perhaps you are blessed with the gift of clairvoyance.#$e#I'm here to observe the Lunaloos... or 'Moonlight Jellies', as you call them. They possess an unusually potent magical aura for an aquatic life form.
records.translation: Paano mo ako natagpuan dito sa likuran? Akala ko, mahusay ang pagkakatago ko.#$b#Marahil ay pinagpala ka ng kakayahang makakita sa hinaharap.#$e#Narito ako para pagmasdan ang mga Lunaloo... o 'Mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan', gaya ng tawag ninyo. Pambihirang malakas ang mahiwagang aura nila para sa isang anyo ng buhay sa tubig.

records.source: Well, summer's over. To be honest, I'll be happy to say goodbye to these blasted mosquitos!
records.translation: Aba, tapos na ang tag-init. Sa totoo lang, ikatutuwa kong magpaalam sa mga pesteng lamok na ito!

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: I hope there are babies this year!
records.translation: Sana may mga sanggol na dikya ngayong taon!

records.source: I wanna see the rare green jelly!
records.translation: Gusto kong makita ang pambihirang berdeng dikya!

records.source: Most night-fish would be scared of the light... these are strange ones.
records.translation: Matatakot sa liwanag ang karamihan sa mga isdang panggabi... kakaiba ang mga ito.

records.source: The moonlight jellies are my old friends... they come to the island every year, too.
records.translation: Matagal ko nang mga kaibigan ang mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan... pumupunta rin sila sa isla bawat taon.

records.source: I brought a blanket for us in case we get cold later.$0#$e#It's a little small, but I'm sure we can make it work...$4
records.translation: Nagdala ako ng kumot para sa atin sakaling lamigin tayo mamaya.$0#$e#Medyo maliit ito, pero tiyak na mapagkakasya natin...$4

records.source: Aww... It's so romantic, with all the candles.$4#$e#Goodbye, Summer...$s
records.translation: Aww... Napakaromantiko dahil sa lahat ng kandila.$4#$e#Paalam, Tag-init...$s

records.source: Do you think I have enough time to grab my telescope from the farmhouse?$0#$e#Hmm... probably not. I don't want to miss this!$0
records.translation: Sa tingin mo, may sapat pa akong oras para kunin ang teleskopyo ko sa Bahay-Bukid?$0#$e#Hmm... malamang wala. Ayokong mapalampas ito!$0

records.source: Hey, there you are!$0#$e#The ocean holds so many secrets and wonders. It's truly amazing.$0
records.translation: Hoy, narito ka pala!$0#$e#Napakaraming lihim at kababalaghan ng karagatan. Talagang kamangha-mangha ito.$0
